policy.stableIdentifier: The exact existing dot-separated key is the stable candidate ID. No existing key is renamed, deleted or silently redirected by this step.
policy.noSilentMerge: Starter template, Mobile/Web examples and Admin Web dictionaries remain separate value sources; this catalogue records provenance only.
policy.noInventedTranslations: This catalogue contains no translation strings. Existing locale values remain in their original dictionaries.
policy.activation: A key is not treated as complete for a surface until its screen/API owner, reviewed English/Hindi value, placeholder contract and QA evidence are mapped.
policy.unknownNamespace: Preserve the observed sourceRoot; do not remap a legacy root to a shared namespace without a traceable alias and approval.
